sources.entry: fable by grooverLab - High-fidelity transcript memory for Claude Code — index every session, recall byte-identical, search, prune, compose. Local-first, stdlib-only, MCP.

summary.one_liner: fable is a local-first CLI and MCP server that indexes Claude Code transcripts into a SQLite archive so Claude and the user can search, recall byte-identical conversations, and prune or compose sessions.
summary.what_it_does: fable indexes every Claude Code session transcript into a local SQLite archive, with an immutable vault that keeps every byte and a search map that supports keyword and optional local embeddings via Ollama. It provides CLI commands to search threads by relevance (filterable by project, kind, and count), assemble a token-budgeted context pack, retrieve a thread's raw turns byte-identically, and view a file's full edit history across sessions. It can prune or export sessions, show index stats, and remember standing rules. An MCP server lets Claude itself search and recall past conversations mid-session, and a web dashboard is served by `fable serve`. The README also describes composing sessions from chosen conversations, a "run cold" mode that mutes recall, and a memory diff that shows what a prune removed.
use_cases: Recall past decisions from earlier Claude Code sessions
Find when a file or function changed and the conversation behind it
Resume a long session after compaction or /clear without losing context
Slim down a heavy session reversibly before resuming it
Keep transcripts beyond Claude Code's 30-day deletion
Run sub-agents or audits without injected prior memory
how_to_run: pipx install git+ (install the CLI; URL truncated in README)
fable install (registers MCP, installs hooks, indexes history)
python3 demo/seed_demo.py && fable --db demo/demo.db serve (try on sample data)
notable: Returns verbatim transcript turns rather than summaries or extracted facts
Immutable vault plus reversible pruning with a preview and Memory Diff
File time-travel reconstructs every Edit and Write across sessions
Composed Sessions stitch chosen conversations into a new resumable session
Local-first: no API keys, no cloud, no daemons, stdlib-only per the listing
caveats: Relies on Claude Code transcript files and hooks, so it depends on how Claude Code stores sessions
Optional semantic search requires a local Ollama install
Install URL in the README is truncated, so exact source location must be checked on GitHub
The README's benchmark numbers come from the author's own archive
